DSBUD-1.payload: DSBUD-1 Then: missing | WHY: the tagged assertion (`"cat mv stat"` sorted-CALLS check in W1) establishes that exactly one stat process runs per `atomic_write` call, covering the second half of the Then ("stat probe runs once at library load, adding no per-atomic_write process cost") — but the first half ("The fork-budget-test.sh still passes") is a claim about a separate test file that the tagged assertion neither runs, calls, nor references; passing the sorted-CALLS assertion does not entail that fork-budget-test.sh as a whole passes | QUOTE: The fork-budget-test.sh still passes after the probe change; the stat probe runs once at library load, adding no per-atomic_write process cost
